cohort: Pregnant women with a pre-pregnancy body mass index (BMI) >= 35 kg/m2 (mean BMI 40.6 +- 4.3 kg/m2).
finding: The dietetic intervention was associated with a significant reduction in gestational weight gain and lower rates of gestational diabetes and caesarean section compared to previous pregnancies or comparable obese populations.
mod_finding: The intervention was associated with lower rates of caesarean delivery.
